premise.claim: The backward-compat-test CI job was failing with `no space left on device` when loading Docker images to the kind cluster.
premise.evidence: GitHub Actions API: base-era run 27287867871 (branch 'policy', 2026-06-10, pre-PR code) failed at step 'Build current fluid docker images' on ALL 5 matrix legs, e2e step skipped; PR-head run 27496321566 (2026-06-14) passes all 5 legs. June job logs are HTTP 410 (expired), so the literal 'no space left on device' message is no longer re-readable — confirmation is at step level, not message level. See results/ci-evidence.md.

ci-observation.cmd: gh api repos/fluid-cloudnative/fluid/actions/runs/<run-id>/jobs (see results/ci-evidence.md for the recorded runs)

findings.title: Fix contract: after each successful `kind load docker-image `, the host-side docker image is removed (`docker rmi `) inside the load loop
findings.evidence: results/l1-head.out PASS on PR head (10 rmi calls, each after its kind load); results/l1-base.out FAIL on base script (0 rmi calls) — harness bites.

findings.title: Robustness contract: a failing `docker rmi` must not abort build-all-images.sh (set -e safety); warning is printed, loop continues, exit 0
findings.evidence: results/l1-rmi-fail.out PASS on PR head with stubbed rmi failure (exit 0, 10 warnings).

findings.title: Workflow contract: 'Free disk space' step present in backward-compat-test, positioned after kind cluster creation and before image build, removing dotnet/android/ghc/CodeQL/ghcup and pruning unused docker images
findings.evidence: results/l1-workflow-head.out PASS on PR head; results/l1-workflow-base.out FAIL on base workflow (step missing) — harness bites. Placement after cluster creation keeps kindest/node in-use so `docker image prune --all --force` cannot remove it.

findings.title: Shared-script blast radius: build-all-images.sh is also called by kind-e2e.yml; the rmi change must not break that workflow
findings.evidence: results/ci-evidence.md: all 5 kind-e2e-test legs success on PR head (run 27496321576); nothing after the load loop consumes the local images (deploy-fluid-to-kind.sh only runs helm against kind-local images; base already pruned all images at script end via cleanup_docker_caches).

liveNote: L2/L3 for this PR is the GitHub Actions run itself: backward-compat-test green on all 5 matrix legs (run 27496321566 on head, 2026-06-14). The only currently failing check on the PR is the 'lint' job, which also fails on the merge base and on the PR's empty first commit — pre-existing, Go-code-only lint job, not touched by this PR.
